resolutions.researcher_notes: DATE CONFLICT ON THE WEST SECTION'S COMMISSIONING YEAR — 2014 vs 2024 — resolved in favour of 2014; 2024 must NOT be staged anywhere on this row or on a WEP3 sibling. Two 2025 state-sector texts carry the phased-commissioning sentence in near-identical wording but with different years for the west section: Xinhua 2025-09-26 says '西段霍尔果斯至中卫段于2014年投产，东段吉安至福州段于2016年投产'; 澎湃/澎湃号·政务 2025-11-04 (a 新疆日报 / 石油系统 piece, mirrored verbatim elsewhere — treated as ONE origin) says '西段霍尔果斯—中卫段于2024年投产，东段吉安—福州段于2016年投产'. Everything else in the record is incompatible with 2024: (a) SASAC, 2018-12-14: 'Now, both the eastern and western segments of the Third West-East Gas Pipeline are finished and fully operational.' (b) 国家能源局西北监管局, 2023-03-28: '截至2022年底，由西气东输一线、二线、三线（西段、东段）组成的西气东输管道系统累计输气量超过8000亿立方米' — the west section is inside the operating system through end-2022. (c) 中新网 2014-09-01: the west section was 全线贯通 in August 2014, and 国家能源局 2012-10-22 already expected 霍尔果斯-乌鲁木齐 in service by end-2012. The 2024 figure is best read as a typo for 2014 in a text whose east-section year is identical to Xinhua's. Flagged rather than silently dropped because the same sentence circulates widely and a future pass will meet it again. NOTHING about this conflict changes the row's Status (operating, already high-sourced) or the staged StartYear1=2014.

resolutions.researcher_notes: SCOPE / AGGREGATE NOTE FOR THE TRUNK PARENT — no existence, duplication or classification problem with this row; it is the genuine WEP3 system row (Khorgas→Fuzhou, 7,378 km) and the parent of P4931 (middle) and P4928 (east). Filed so the merge can see which figures are system-scoped and which are not. (1) SEGMENTCOST: the sheet's 125,000,000,000 RMB is CORRECT for this row and IS sourced at system scope — 中新网 2012-10-22, '西三线包括1条干线8条支线3座储气库和1座液化天然气应急调峰站，总投资1250亿元'. The carried v2 __VALIDITY__ on SegmentCost scope is therefore RESOLVED for this row, and the ref already in the cell is live (see the encoding caveat below). Three OTHER investment figures exist for WEP3 and none of them belongs in this cell: 1160 亿元 (Baosteel, a 2012 preliminary estimate for the JV's scope), 超过1200 亿元 (国家能源局 2012-10-22, a rounded contemporaneous figure), and 436.48 亿元 (the 2014 NDRC 核准 for the MIDDLE section only — a SECTION figure; RELAUNCH_NOTES item 3 also lists 44.7e9 / 436.48亿 as WEP3 system-vs-segment traps). resolutions.researcher_notes: OWNERSHIP STRUCTURE — a decision is owed at merge, and the staged Owner1 = PipeChina 100% is a default, not a documented equity figure. WEP3 is the one Chinese trunk that was deliberately opened to outside capital, and the only equity split any primary document states is the 2012 PLANNED JV in Baosteel's SSE announcement 临 2012-050: 中国石油 325亿/约52%, 宝钢股份 80亿/约12.8%, 华宝投资 20亿/约3.2%, plus 全国社保基金 and 北京国联能源产业投资基金（有限合伙）; registered capital 625亿, 20-year term, '委托中石油集团下属管道运营专业公司负责项目建设和日常运行'. 国家能源局 2012-10-22 independently confirms the 2012-05-30 《西气东输三线管道项目合资合作框构协议》 with 中石油、全国社保基金理事会、城市基础设施产业投资基金、宝钢集团 and calls it '国内油气管道领域首创'. Every one of those figures is prospective (拟 / 框构协议) and NOTHING found in this pass confirms the JV was formed on those terms, survived the 2019-2020 PipeChina restructuring, or holds the pipe today. What IS documented today is operatorship, not equity: NDRC's 2023 appendix 《国家管网集团经营的跨省天然气管道表》 lists both WEP3 sections, and 国家管网集团西北公司 / 西气东输公司南昌输气分公司 run it. Note also that the sheet's own QCCOwner(业主单位) names 国家管网集团西部管道有限责任公司 first, i.e. a PipeChina SUBSIDIARY for the west section — if the merge prefers subsidiary-level precision over the parent, that is the candidate, and RELAUNCH_NOTES item 2's warning (the 46% Phase-I holder is the SUBSIDIARY 东部原油储运有限公司, not the parent) is the analogous trap here. RECOMMENDATION: apply PipeChina 100% consistently across the three trunk parents (P4657/P4934/P4947 all landed on the same value and tier), and adjudicate the 2012 minority stakes once, for the whole WEP3 family, rather than row by row.
